name: admin-app-deferred-service-handles
description: All 12 additional firebase-admin modular service factories (getAppCheck, getDataConnect, getEventarc, getExtensions, getFunctions, getInstallations, getInstanceId, getMachineLearning, getPhoneNumberVerification, getProjectManagement, getRemoteConfig, getSecurityRules) and the 7 matching root admin.*() accessors throw FirebaseAppError app/no-app before initializeApp(), and after initializeApp() resolve the default or named App synchronously without network I/O, bind handle.app === app, and cache per app (with DataConnect cached per location-serviceId). rowIds empty — admin-bootstrap capture; admin matrix rows land post-publish.
